SYMPTOM: Parakeet models stopped showing in npm run tauri dev after Windows port — showed as 'preloading' but never worked.

CAUSE: Windows port commit changed `default = ["fluidaudio"]` to `default = []` in Cargo.toml. All dev scripts run `tauri dev` without `--features fluidaudio`, so the compile-time `#[cfg(not(feature = "fluidaudio"))]` guard in model_resolver.rs silently filtered out all Parakeet models.

FIX:
1. Restored `default = ["fluidaudio"]` in src-tauri/Cargo.toml
2. Changed every `#[cfg(feature = "fluidaudio")]` to `#[cfg(all(feature = "fluidaudio", target_os = "macos"))]` across:
   - src-tauri/src/lib.rs
   - src-tauri/src/transcription/components/mod.rs
   - src-tauri/src/inference/manager.rs
   - src-tauri/src/model_management/model_registry.rs
   - src-tauri/src/model_management/model_resolver.rs (also the `not()` guard)
3. Also added `#![cfg(all(feature = "fluidaudio", target_os = "macos"))]` file-level guards to fluidaudio_ffi.rs and FluidAudio backend files

RESULT: macOS dev gets fluidaudio by default, Windows compiles all FluidAudio code away even with feature enabled. cargo check passes, 1850/1856 tests pass (6 pre-existing failures).

PREVENT: Never remove fluidaudio from defaults — add target_os guards instead.
